# Index the latest 25 release notes in sitemap-core.xml and seo.json

## Problem

`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` (`getMaxReleaseMajor` / `isIndexableReleaseVersion`), `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`, and `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` currently gate release-note indexability by semver major (`releaseMajor >= maxReleaseMajor - 1`).

Because Neo.mjs ships frequent major versions (`v10` -> `v11` -> `v12` -> `v13` -> `v14`), `major >= maxMajor - 1` starves search discovery of recent release history:
- On live `neomjs.com` (`maxMajor = 13`), `sitemap-core.xml` only advertises **8** release notes (`13.4.0`..`12.0.0`), marking all `v11.x` releases (`11.24.0`..`11.12.0`, including `11.16.0` Neural Link) as `robots: "noindex, follow"`.
- On `dev` (`maxMajor = 14`), `major >= 13` drops `12.1.0` and `12.0.0` as well, leaving only **7** release notes (`14.0.0` + `13.4.0`..`13.0.0`) across the full corpus (`173` total release notes) and marking **18 of the latest 25** release notes `noindex, follow`.

Per operator SEO/GSC review (`2026-11-21`), the latest **25** release notes (`14.0.0` down to `11.12.0` on current corpus) must remain indexable in `sitemap-core.xml` and `seo.json`.

## Scope & Acceptance Criteria

1. **Count-based indexable window (`25` latest semver releases):**
   - Replace the two-major cutoff (`major >= maxMajor - 1`) across `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs`, `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`, and `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` with a deterministic top-`25` semver-descending release set (`INDEXABLE_RELEASE_LIMIT = 25`, e.g. `getIndexableReleaseVersions(versions, limit = 25)`).
   - Release notes within the top `25` discovered versions omit `robots: "noindex, follow"` in `seo.json` and are emitted into `sitemap-core.xml` (and `llms.txt`); older historical release notes beyond rank `25` retain `robots: "noindex, follow"` in `seo.json` and stay out of `sitemap-core.xml`.
2. **Verification & Unit Coverage:**
   - Update `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` assertions and error messages to enforce the top-`25` semver window instead of `< v${maxReleaseMajor - 1}`.
   - Update `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Verify.spec.mjs` to cover a `> 25` multi-major release set (verifying ranks `1..25` are indexable in `sitemap-core.xml` / `seo.json` and rank `26+` gets `robots: "noindex, follow"`).
3. **Sequencing / Collision Guard:**
   - Sequence implementation immediately after PR `#21810` (`#21808`) lands so `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` and `Generate.spec.mjs` do not conflict during the `v14.0.0` release cut (`#21775`).

## Content Sweep Evidence
- Live open queue (`list_issues` on `neomjs/neo`, `57` open) and KB (`#20671`, `#19047`, `#9592`) checked; no open ticket tracks replacing the 2-major release-note SEO cutoff with a 25-release window.

## Timeline

### @neo-gpt-sophie - 2026-11-21T19:32:57Z

Independent cutoff check against the Pages corpus pin `c40472f2791ab20917f41f51a17e54a093875174` plus Engine 14 gives 173 distinct valid versions. The current two-major rule admits 7. The proposed window admits 25, ending at `11.12.0`. Rank 26 is `11.11.0`.

I also ran the current generators against that exact corpus in a disposable directory. The catalog contains all 173 release records, 7 are indexable, and the core sitemap has the same 7 release URLs. Rank 25 currently carries `noindex, follow`. The existing full release listing in `llms.txt` already includes both ranks 25 and 26.

For the regression, rank 25 appears in the core sitemap and stays indexable in the catalog. Rank 26 stays out of the core sitemap and carries `noindex, follow` in the catalog. The current verifier loops over present entries to check historical exclusions, so the positive assertion matters.
